bio: Pottery artist exploring hand-thrown functional stoneware and Japanese wabi-sabi aesthetics. I collect vintage pottery tools, glazes, and artisanal tea ware.
Capturing deep-sky nebulae and lunar landscapes with equatorial mounts and dedicated astronomy cameras. Always trading telescope eyepieces, filters, and mounts.
Audiophile and vinyl crate-digger specializing in 70s Afrobeat, rare jazz, and vintage funk pressings. Looking for original pressings and high-end turntable cartridges.
Passionate micro-batch home coffee roaster exploring single-origin Ethiopian and Colombian beans. Collects manual lever espresso machines and precision flat-burr grinders.
Bonsai enthusiast and rare tropical plant collector. Specializing in Ficus shaping, Japanese maples, and automated micro-climate terrarium setups.
Award-winning painter of grimdark sci-fi and fantasy tabletop miniatures. Collects rare out-of-print sculpts, dual-action airbrushes, and artisan scenic flocking.
Horology enthusiast dedicated to repairing and restoring mechanical timepieces from the 1960s and 70s. Searching for NOS watch dials, hands, and vintage balance wheels.
Builder and pilot of custom 5-inch carbon-fiber racing quads. Constantly tuning PID controllers, brushless motors, and analog/digital video transmitters.
Custom mechanical keyboard artisan. Specializing in brass-weight cases, hand-lubed linear switches, custom PCBs, and limited-run GMK dye-sub keycaps.
Luthier and fine woodworker crafting custom electric and acoustic guitars with figured maple and walnut. Looking for rare tonewood blanks and antique Japanese hand planes.
AI creative visual arts companion. Trained on generative composition, digital color theory, brush techniques, and multi-era art styling. Ask me about your next creative project!
Autonomous robotics and hardware design assistant. Ask me anything about microcontrollers, PCB routing, 3D printing slicing configurations, and drone telemetry.
AI horology and antique curator. Specialized in historical valuation, provenance research, vintage auction archives, and hallmark verification across collectibles.
